data.name: SettingsIntro
data.value: Workflows receive REDACTED values by default. Protected Workflows let an administrator approve one specific workflow to send selected protected fields to one pinned HTTPS destination. Every other workflow keeps receiving REDACTED values.

data.name: SecondApproverLabel
data.value: Require a second administrator to approve protected workflows

data.name: WarningText
data.value: Protected Workflows send decrypted protected data, which may include protected health information, to external systems you configure. Resgrid cannot control how the receiving system stores or uses this data. Only enable a workflow if the recipient is your organization or a party covered by a business associate agreement with your organization, and only release the fields the recipient needs.

data.name: WarningAckLabel
data.value: I have read and acknowledge this warning (version {0}).

data.name: AdpRequired
data.value: Protected Workflows are available only while Advanced Data Protection is enabled for your department.

data.name: NotAdmin
data.value: Only administrators with the Configure Protected Data Delivery permission can change these settings.

data.name: StepUpNotice
data.value: Turning this setting on or off, and approving or renewing a release, requires a fresh multi-factor verification.

data.name: StepUpRequiredPrompt
data.value: This action needs a fresh multi-factor verification. You will be taken to verify and then brought back to this page; repeat the action afterwards.

data.name: PanelIntro
data.value: Send selected protected fields from this workflow to its pinned HTTPS destination. Only the fields you tick are decrypted; every other protected value stays REDACTED.

data.name: FieldsHelp
data.value: Nothing is selected by default. Reference released fields in the output template as protected.call.<name>; call.* values stay REDACTED.

data.name: FormParsedHelp
data.value: Form data is also available parsed as protected.call.form.

data.name: ValidationHeader
data.value: This workflow cannot be protected yet

data.name: ValidationError_no_steps

data.name: ValidationError_credential_mismatch
data.value: Every step must use the same credential.

data.name: ValidationError_credential_not_allowed
data.value: Use a Bearer token, API key or OAuth2 client credentials credential.

data.name: ValidationError_scheme_not_https

data.name: ValidationError_host_mismatch

data.name: ValidationError_protected_in_action_config

data.name: ValidationError_protected_in_condition

data.name: ValidationError_token_url_invalid
data.value: The OAuth2 credential needs an HTTPS token URL.

data.name: ValidationError_protected_reference_without_release

data.name: TestSucceeded

data.name: TestFailed

data.name: AwaitingSecondApprover

data.name: ReadOnlyNotice
data.value: Only administrators with the Configure Protected Data Delivery permission can change the protected release. Editing this workflow suspends an approved release until it is approved again.

data.name: SkippedNotice
data.value: While this workflow has a protected release that is not Active, its runs are skipped. It never runs with REDACTED values in place of the protected ones.

data.name: DepartmentOffNotice
data.value: Protected Workflows are turned off for your department. Turn them on under Data Protection to configure a protected release.

data.name: Err_host_mismatch

data.name: Err_redirect_refused
data.value: The destination answered with a redirect. Redirects are never followed for protected data.

data.name: Err_token_host_mismatch

data.name: Err_broker_failed
data.value: The protected values could not be decrypted. Nothing was sent.

data.name: Err_entity_unavailable

data.name: Err_render_failed
data.value: The template could not be rendered. Nothing was sent.

data.name: Err_payload_too_large
data.value: The rendered payload is too large. Nothing was sent.

data.name: Err_envelope_in_payload
data.value: The rendered payload contained encrypted data and was blocked.

data.name: Err_http_timeout
data.value: The destination did not respond in time.

data.name: Err_protected_step_error
data.value: The step failed. The cause is not recorded, to keep protected values out of the logs.

data.name: Err_payload_invalid
data.value: The rendered payload is not valid for its content type. Nothing was sent.

data.name: Err_projection_failed
data.value: The subject identifiers on the call could not be read. Nothing was sent.

data.name: Err_ack_rejected
data.value: The destination received the request but rejected it.

data.name: Err_response_too_large
data.value: The destination's response was larger than allowed, so it could not be checked.

data.name: Err_part2_consent_missing
data.value: The call has no 42 CFR Part 2 consent on file, so its Part 2 fields were not sent.

data.name: Err_capture_failed
data.value: The request was delivered, but the values returned by the destination could not be saved on the call.

data.name: Err_oauth_token_failed
data.value: The OAuth2 token endpoint did not issue a token.

data.name: Err_auth_method_mismatch
data.value: The credential no longer authenticates the way this release approved.

data.name: Err_signing_key_unavailable
data.value: The credential has no current signing key.

data.value: Release individual identifiers instead of the whole set: only the ticked keys reach protected.call.subject_ids.

data.name: CustomFieldsHelp
data.value: Each ticked custom field is decrypted on its own and renders as protected.call.udf.<name>.

data.value: 42 CFR Part 2: the selected fields contain substance use disorder information. Redisclosing it requires the patient's written consent or another basis permitted by 42 CFR Part 2, and the recipient must be told that further redisclosure is prohibited.

data.name: Part2ConsentNotice
data.value: A call is only sent when "Part 2 consent on file" is set on it; otherwise the step is blocked and recorded.

data.name: StepOptionsHelp
data.value: How the destination confirms receipt, which returned values are saved on the call, and how retries are recognized. Every option here is part of the release approval.

data.value: One per line: source | expression | key. Sources: json_path, xpath, hl7_field, header, fhir_location_id. Values are saved encrypted in the call's subject identifiers.
